title: salix grandifolia
intro: Salix grandifolia, commonly known as River Birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. The health benefits of River Birch include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of River Birch include its use as a diuretic to treat urinary tract issues and its potential to lower blood pressure due to its vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of River Birch include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
